offering_description.value: The Eastern Company sells reusable transport packaging, commercial vehicle vision systems, and industrial access hardware to manufacturers and aftermarket buyers. It designs and manufactures these products, including custom packaging for parts moving through automotive production.

primary_products.value: reusable transport racks and containers; commercial vehicle mirrors; vehicle camera systems; industrial latches and locks; hinges and handles

customer_segment.value: B2B: automakers, automotive suppliers, commercial vehicle manufacturers, industrial equipment makers and aftermarket parts distributors

end_markets.value: automotive manufacturing; commercial vehicles; industrial equipment and enclosures; automotive aftermarket

revenue_model.value: product sales: transport packaging, mirrors, camera systems and access hardware

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns metals, plastics and purchased components into packaging, vision systems and hardware for manufacturers and aftermarket distributors

geography_served.value: global: North America and Asia, including the United States, Canada, Mexico, China and Taiwan

specialization.value: related lines: reusable transport packaging, commercial vehicle vision systems and industrial access hardware

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: automakers, vehicle manufacturers and other industrial customers; distributors / dealers: commercial vehicle aftermarket parts distributors and industrial hardware distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: commercial vehicle visibility standards and environmental and workplace safety rules for manufacturing

notes: The current status of the mold and tooling operation is uncertain.
